data.name: Rukmarathi
data.gender_notes: Rukmarathi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from two words: Rukma (golden) and Rathi (chariot). Represents divine power and purity. The name Rukmarathi carries the meaning “Golden Chariot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Rukmarathi usually hope their child will grow to embody golden chariot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine journey and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Rukmarathi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden Chariot.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukmarathi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu mythology, chariots are considered divine vehicles that carry gods. The name "Rukmarathi" represents a golden chariot, which symbolizes wealth, power, and glory. It is a name that evokes a sense of auspiciousness and grandeur.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Rukmarathi" is more than just a symbol of wealth and power; it also carries deep spiritual meaning. The golden chariot represents the vehicle that carries the divine soul to the ultimate destination of enlightenment. The name serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual journey and the divine power that drives it. In essence, the name "Rukmarathi" represents the harmony of spiritual growth and material prosperity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rukmarathi: The name Rukma signifies gold or wealth, and Rathi represents a chariot. Thus, Rukmarathi symbolizes one who rides on the chariot of wealth and prosperity.
